## Clinical Philosophy & Core Principles
1. Comprehensive Hands-On Clinical Examination: Every consultation starts with physical joint palpation, range-of-motion testing, ligament stress testing, and direct examination of original radiographic films with the patient on the clinic viewbox.
2. Conservative Joint Preservation First: Over 70% of joint and spine consultations are managed successfully through targeted physical therapy, kinetic chain strengthening, unloader bracing, viscosupplementation (hyaluronic acid), and biological injections without surgery.
3. Tissue-Sparing Precision Arthroplasty: When surgical intervention is required (e.g., end-stage Grade 4 osteoarthritis), Dr. Sharma performs muscle-sparing subvastus exposures and anatomical alignment with high-durability biocompatible implants (ceramic-on-polyethylene, cobalt-chromium).
4. Early Day-1 Bedside Mobilization: Joint replacement patients stand and take assisted steps on Day 1 (within 24 hours of surgery) under guided physiotherapy protocols to prevent thromboembolism and accelerate recovery.
5. Strict Ethical Compliance: Practice strictly adheres to the National Medical Commission (NMC) Registered Medical Practitioner Regulations 2023. No commercial guarantees, no exaggerated superlatives, and no unsolicited patient promotional endorsements.

## Clinical Areas of Care & Specialized Procedures
- Total Knee Replacement (TKR): Tricompartmental Grade 4 osteoarthritis, mechanical axial realignment, tissue-sparing exposure.
- Partial / Unicondylar Knee Replacement (UKA): Isolated medial compartment wear with intact ACL; smaller incision, rapid recovery.
- Total Hip Replacement (THR): Avascular necrosis (AVN stage 3/4), end-stage hip arthritis; ceramic delta heads, anatomical leg-length restoration.
- Complex Knee & Revision Surgeries: Failed previous implants, severe angular deformities, modular constraint and porous metal augments.
- Bipolar Hemiarthroplasty: Elderly femoral neck fragility fractures; dual-articulating head for early weight-bearing and bed-confinement prevention.
- Knee Arthroscopy & ACL/PCL Reconstruction: Autograft anatomical ligament reconstruction, early pivoting stability.
- Meniscus Repair & Preservation: All-inside and inside-out micro-suturing to preserve native fibrocartilage shock absorption.
- Shoulder Arthroscopy & Rotator Cuff Repair: Keyhole decompression, suture anchor re-fixation, frozen shoulder release.
- Intra-Articular Fracture Fixation (ORIF): Anatomical reduction of joint surfaces using fixed-angle titanium locking plates.
- Closed Interlocking Nailing: Femur and tibia shaft fractures without opening the fracture hematoma; biological bone healing.
- Daycare Nerve & Tendon Decompressions: Carpal tunnel release and trigger finger release under local anesthesia (discharge in 2-3 hours).
- De Quervain's Tenosynovitis Release: First dorsal extensor compartment decompression protecting the superficial radial nerve.
